set.body: Evidence: ResultSemantics and ModelSpec use SolverGuarantee, proof-bearing fits use OptimizationClaimClass plus AchievedOptimizationGuarantee, and FittedLatentEncoder defines LatentEncodingAchievement. Acceptance: name program-side values as requested claims; use one evidence-bearing achieved result vocabulary across operator solvers and latent encoding; retain quantitative residuals and certificates; confine or migrate the legacy enum at the IR boundary with version-safe tests on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: Separate requested optimization claims from achieved guarantees
